components.name: OmniThreadLibrary
components.notes: Prefer units_folder for the package directory, including subfolders, or units_exact for unit names. A units_prefix with no dot is not applied. Replace the path or remove it. A missing folder is a warning.

components.name: Spring4D
components.notes: Dependency injection and collections framework. The folder covers the package. units_exact covers units known only by name.

components.name: SynEdit
components.notes: An SPDX expression is emitted as licenses[].expression. The folder replaces a short prefix.

components.name: TMS VCL UI Pack
components.notes: Optional purl overrides the generated pkg:delphi locator. Commercial is emitted as license.name. A prefix that contains a dot still matches the start of the unit name, except on an Embarcadero product path. Prefer the folder for the VCL package.

components.name: OpenSSL
components.notes: Optional cpe. DX.Comply writes this value and does not look one up or build one from the name. A CPE 2.2 URI such as cpe:/a:openssl:openssl:3.0.2 is also accepted. Anything else is a warning and is left out. units_exact names the unit. A units_prefix with no dot is not applied.
